changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE task_activity_logs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_activity_logs_action_type_check;

ALTER TABLE task_activity_logs ADD CONSTRAINT task_activity_logs_action_type_check CHECK (action_type IN ( 'CREATE_TASK', 'UPDATE_INFO', 'UPDATE_STATUS', 'UPDATE_FIELD', 'UPDATE_PROGRESS', 'SYSTEM_UPDATE', 'ASSIGN_MEMBER', 'REMOVE_MEMBER', 'MEMBER_SUBMIT', 'UPLOAD_FILE', 'ADD_COMMENT', 'UPDATE_MEMBER_ROLE', 'UPDATE_MEMBER_STATUS', 'ADD_REQUIREMENT', 'ASSIGN_REQUIREMENT', 'COMPLETE_REQUIREMENT', 'UNCOMPLETE_REQUIREMENT', 'CLOSE_TASK' ));
